name: Wilmot Dow
role: Co-manager of Theodore Roosevelt's Elkhorn ranch
bio: Wilmot Dow was put in charge of Theodore Roosevelt's Elkhorn ranch with William Sewall in August 1884, married in Maine in summer 1885, and returned with his wife and Mrs. Sewall that August. In late March 1886 he went with Roosevelt and Sewall to catch the men who had stolen Roosevelt's boat, and in October 1886 he left for Maine with his family.

moments.label: Helped Roosevelt overtake the boat thieves

Word comes in a rather round-about way that Wilmot Dow, one of the managers of the Elkhorn ranch was married last week in Maine. We commiserate.
Wilmot Dow and wife arrived from Maine last Sunday evening in company with Mrs. Sewall. They are now at home at the Elkhorn ranch.
